import openpyxl, os, datetime
out=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
ws=wb.active
# gather table1
rows=[]
for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1):
    sid=ws.cell(r,1).value
    vd=ws.cell(r,3).value
    if sid is not None and isinstance(vd, datetime.datetime):
        rows.append((sid, vd))
sid=ws['H2'].value
sub=ws['I2'].value
best=None
for s,v in rows:
    if s==sid and v<sub:
        if best is None or v>best:
            best=v
ws['J2']=best
wb.save(out)
print('J2=',best)
